about.title: From home to Chemnitz
about.lead: The Bangladesh Student Union Chemnitz is a community of Bangladeshi students building a new home together — far from home, but never alone.
about.body: From your very first week to graduation, we bring people together through culture, friendship, and real support for life in a new country.
about.p1Text: A family away from family, from the day you arrive.
about.p2Text: Celebrating our roots — Boishakh, Eid, music and food.
about.p3Text: Guidance for paperwork, housing and university life.
